label: The sibling still runs DEPTH ('single thinking system', ALWAYS-loaded reference, perspective minimums); its divergence is deliver-first interaction, routing hygiene and per-mode scorers — it is evidence for REQ-004/005/006 only, not for what replaces DEPTH.

REQ-004 mechanics: ask only when no prompt AND no task, two commands conflict, or non-prompt work needs one reframe; every other gap is a soft default reported as a numbered '### Open items' entry after the deliverable; never inside the prompt; 3 unresolved clarifications then smart defaults.

strip_source_prompt() strips fenced blocks, quoted spans >=3 words (1-2 stay), else 'prompt:' lead-in text; returns (own, has_source); whole-$token commands, >=2 mode commands = conflict to INTERACTIVE, word-boundary keywords, bare pasted prompt routes IMPROVE.

REQ-006 precedent verified: project-level benchmark/router = 32-case fixtures.json + route_contract.py + kernel_parity.py + run_fixtures.sh asserting exact routing and kernel-minus-comments parity; the shape to copy is one executable contract, one JSON fixture list, one shell runner.

Command DEPTH couplings are structural: auto phase_2 spells D-E-P-T-H inline steps, confirm approval_gates trigger after_discover/after_prototype/after_test, presentation sells '10 DEPTH rounds' and prints 'DEPTH Rounds: [N]' — a rebuild must rename checkpoints and substitute the display field.

Internal contradiction in sk-prompt today: depth-framework.md caps improvement at 1 cycle while both command YAMLs + presentation iterate up to 3 cycles before failing — the live caller contract is 3; the rebuild needs one number.

The ask-first gap is ordering not bound-existence: presentation already caps question interactions (3/1/0) then defaults; SKILL.md §4 makes the question blocking before processing and the command gate blocks until prompt_input — REQ-004 moves the bound to post-delivery open items.

Effort-knob precedent: the sibling's one allowed question offers quick-vs-deep defaulting to Standard — a ready-made replacement semantic for DEPTH energy levels that $short/$refine/complexity_hint currently encode.

Sibling scorer design is per-mode (CLEAR 40/50 text, EVOKE 40/50 visual-UI, VISUAL 48/60-56/70 media) with 3 improvement cycles then best-effort-with-note; for text-only sk-prompt this supports REQ-007's single thin CLEAR screen.

Agent wire contract survives DEPTH removal: the five-field block + BLOCKED shape + model-eligibility matrix are orthogonal; internal changes are limited to ANALYZE framework-scoring, COMPOSE DEPTH-energy, VALIDATE CLEAR-floor references; FRAMEWORK field can keep a name without breaking callers.
